proposedEntry.name: design-system-governance
proposedEntry.description: Makes the agent define how a design system evolves: seven core governance questions, three ownership models (centralized/federated/hybrid) with trade-offs, a seven-stage contribution lifecycle from proposal to communicated release, semver as the consumer contract with a patch/minor/major table, a deprecation process with timelines and in-product warnings, breaking-change policy (migration guides, codemods, shims), and component quality entry standards.
